title: open field state and card expiry
name: Open field state and card expiry
rule: Open field, not iOS picker/dropdown, for state and card expiry.
pass_when: State and card expiry are open fields (typeable), not iOS pickers/dropdowns.
fail_when: State or expiry uses a picker/dropdown as the only entry.
overview: State and card expiry use open typeable fields, not pickers alone.
apply_when: Collecting state or card expiry on forms, especially mobile checkout.
not_when: State or expiry available only via iOS picker or dropdown.
agent_hint: Use open typeable fields for state and card expiry, not picker-only entry.
description: State and card expiry should be open fields users can type into, not iOS pickers or dropdowns as the only entry method. Pass when state and card expiry are open typeable fields. Fail when state or expiry uses a picker or dropdown as the only entry path, blocking faster typing for familiar values such as state codes and expiry dates.
